name: pr-watch
description: Tracks GitLab MRs and GitHub PRs created during the session and shows their state, pipeline, approval and unresolved threads in a band above the prompt, with clickable ids

icons.title: Icon set
icons.description: Icon set for the band: nerd (needs a Nerd Font terminal) or emoji

gitlabHost.title: GitLab host
gitlabHost.description: GitLab hostname used by /pr-track for group/project!iid and bare !iid refs

defaultProject.title: Default GitLab project
defaultProject.description: group/project assumed by /pr-track for bare !iid refs; empty disables them
